note.zh-CN: 官方 2026 路线图与起终点平面图已发布。路线描述新增中共一大会址、龙华寺、龙华烈士陵园；终点写为中山南二路（徐家汇体育公园）；完赛流线从上海体育场4号通道进场、1号通道出场，不再沿用 2025 警方通告的12号门说法。
note.en: The official 2026 course map and start/finish diagrams were published. The course description adds the Site of the First CPC Congress, Longhua Temple and Longhua Martyrs' Cemetery; the finish is given as Zhongshan South 2nd Road (Xujiahui Sports Park); the finish flow enters Shanghai Stadium via Passage 4 and exits via Passage 1, rather than the Gate 12 wording in the 2025 police notice.

courseChanges.to: route adjusted to avoid sharp curves and narrow roads for the new wheelchair discipline; five barrier-free toilets placed along the way

note.zh-CN: 2024 年首次增设竞速轮椅项目，赛道避让急弯与窄路，沿线设五处无障碍厕所。
note.en: The 2024 route avoided sharp curves and narrow roads to suit the newly added racing wheelchair discipline, with five barrier-free toilets on the course.

courseChanges.to: three-gun start; finish cut-off extended to 13:30

note.zh-CN: 2025 采用三枪起跑，终点关门顺延至 13:30；2026 改为六枪分段出发，关门时刻以 2026 官方路线图为准。
note.en: The 2025 race used a three-gun start and extended the finish cut-off to 13:30; the 2026 race uses six waves, and cut-off times follow the 2026 official map.

details.direction: Point-to-point from the Bund Bull (外滩金牛广场) on Zhongshan East 1st Road to the Xujiahui Sports Park finish on Zhongshan South 2nd Road
details.distanceMethod: Official 2026 competition rules and official participant guide both state 42.195 km; the rules mark the half-marathon split at 21.0975 km. No conflicting full-marathon distance found.
details.attribution: 2026 官方路线图与起终点平面图为赛事方版权 JPEG 图件，正文与来源仅外链，不记作可导航轨迹
